title.en: Groq API Key - High Speed AI Inference | Get Model Key
title.zh: Groq API Key - 高速 AI 推理 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Groq API key for high-speed AI inference. Access ultra-fast model responses with LPU architecture.
description.zh: 获取 Groq API Key，访问高速 AI 推理。使用 LPU 架构获得超快的模型响应。

en: Groq focuses on ultra-fast inference using its LPU hardware stack, which is popular for low-latency chat, agents, and batch workloads.
The console exposes API keys and OpenAI-compatible style endpoints so many existing clients can switch base URL with minimal code changes.
Get Model Key links console.groq.com/keys only. We do not issue Groq keys or resell inference credit.
zh: Groq 依托 LPU 硬件做超低延迟推理，适合对响应速度敏感的对话、Agent 与批处理场景。
控制台提供 API Key，并常见 OpenAI 兼容风格接口，许多现有客户端只需改 base URL 即可接入。
Get Model Key 仅链接 console.groq.com/keys。本站不发放 Groq Key，也不转售推理额度。

en: Sign in at https://console.groq.com/keys (create a Groq account if needed).
Generate a new API key and store it securely—treat it like a password.
Point your client at Groq’s documented API base URL and send Authorization: Bearer <key>.
Check https://console.groq.com/docs for model names, rate limits, and usage dashboards.
zh: 打开 https://console.groq.com/keys 登录（如无账号先注册）。
生成新的 API Key，并妥善保存，视同密码管理。
将客户端指向文档中的 Groq API 地址，使用 Authorization: Bearer <key> 调用。
查阅 https://console.groq.com/docs 确认模型名、限流与用量面板。

question.en: Why choose Groq over other hosts?

answer.en: Teams often pick Groq for LPU-backed speed and simple key-based API access. Compare latency and model coverage against your workload.
answer.zh: 许多团队看重其 LPU 加速与简单的 Key 接入方式。请结合自身负载对比延迟与模型覆盖。

question.en: Can I reuse an OpenAI SDK with Groq?
question.zh: Groq 能用 OpenAI SDK 吗？

answer.en: Often yes if you set Groq’s documented base URL and your Groq API key. Verify request fields per Groq docs.
answer.zh: 通常可以：配置文档中的 base URL 与 Groq API Key。具体字段以 Groq 文档为准。

question.en: Does this site sell Groq API keys?
question.zh: 本站出售 Groq API Key 吗？

answer.en: No. Get Model Key only points to the official keys console. Billing stays on Groq.
answer.zh: 不出售。Get Model Key 只指向官方 Keys 控制台，计费在 Groq 完成。
